hypothesis: Coins whose visible order book cannot absorb institutional size earn a persistent return premium relative to otherwise comparable liquid coins, because the marginal buyer pool structurally excludes professional capital. Measured support for the exclusion, not for the premium: 25% of micro-tier books and 8% of low-tier books could not fill a $10,000 market order at any price on visible depth (57 Bybit books, 2026-08-05). A fund of $50M taking a 1% position needs $500k, roughly fifty times what those books hold. Tested long-only, equal-weight within a capacity band, rebalanced annually, at $1,000 order size.
notes: Highest prior risk of being a survivorship artifact of the four.
Capacity bands are computed from venue turnover, not from aggregator volume, which is inflated by wash trading.
refutation: REFUTED if the capacity-excluded band does not beat the liquid band, net of the measured cost model, over the holdout. ALSO REFUTED, and this is the outcome the dataset was built to detect, if the excess disappears once coins that died are included at their real terminal values - that would identify the premium as survivorship rather than illiquidity. A positive result on survivors-only data is not evidence for this hypothesis and will not be reported as any.

benchmark: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same point-in-time universe
selection_criterion.construction: equal-weight within capacity band, annual rebalance
selection_criterion.costs: docs/CRYPTO_LOWCAP_COST_MODEL.md measured model, p75 quantile, $1,000 order size, non-executable books = no trade

also_reported: DSR with observed variance, new ledger only
DSR with the 109-trial ETF ledger combined (N=124)
deflated_sharpe.n_trials_policy: the DECLARED budget is used even if fewer are spent
deflated_sharpe.sharpe_variance_floor_source: cross-trial variance of the 109-trial ETF ledger
deflated_sharpe.variance_policy: max(observed across this experiment's trials, floor)

selection_criterion.power_limitation_declared: a 2.69-year holdout has a standard error of roughly 0.75 on an annualized Sharpe, so it cannot separate a true Sharpe of 1.0 from 0; the verdict is a range, not a point, and will be reported as one
selection_criterion.validation: walk-forward with embargo, same methodology as the ETF study

universe: membership: point-in-time CMC snapshot at each date, cmc_id identity
screen: cmc_rank <= 1000 on the rebalance date
tradability: venue klines required on the rebalance date (bybit or binance spot USDT)
prices: venue klines only; snapshot prices are cross-check, never execution
excluded: stablecoins (declared filter), coins with no vetted-venue listing
